description: How a benchmark task is judged against a capability's research gate in spec/contracts/capability-registry.v1.json. A record that names a capability must use exactly this task, version and tolerance, and its metrics carry the gate's names. The harness (JovraBenchmark) and scripts/spec/validate.py both read this file. An analysis ticket adds the binding for its capability in the same PR as its task.

bindings.rationale: A predicted onset matches a truth hit within 50 ms, the matching window of the MIREX audio onset detection evaluation; the gate's onset MAE (<= 10 ms) then measures timing inside that window. The eventTimes task counts every truth event, so a capability record must gate on clips whose events are all own-court hits (the harness and synthetic corpus clips are).
